messages:
Maya K.: Hey team — candidate for Senior Infra is scheduled Thurs at 11:00am PT. Panel listed: Samir, Jordan, Priya. Can someone confirm they can run the debrief and who will take notes? Also quick rubric q: do we weight system-design heavier for this role?

Samir Patel: I can run debriefs, happy to help. Note-taking: I can take notes if Jordan can't, but I'm off 11:40–12:20 PT so prefer not to anchor the full loop. For rubric, we usually give system design more weight for senior infra — I'd say ~60% design/tradeoffs, 40% coding + comms.

Jordan Lee: I can take notes and run the debrief. Quick flag: 11:00 conflicts for me — can we shift to 11:30?

Maya K.: @Jordan Lee 11:30 ok? @Katie (recruiter) can you confirm candidate availability and update the invite if so?

Katie (recruiter): Candidate is good with 11:30. Updated calendar invite and added dial-in. @Jordan Lee you are the debrief lead, Samir will take notes. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: One more rubric clarification — when we ask about latency/cost tradeoffs, do we expect a high-level tradeoff narrative or a back-of-envelope calc? My read: ask for a sketch and 1–2 sanity numbers; concrete math is a plus but not required.

Jordan Lee: Agreed. I'll nudge them to do a quick back-of-envelope if they dodge.

Maya K.: Added the interview packet here for reviewers: https://redwood.app/interviews/packet/789 (includes suggested prompts and rubric link).

Samir Patel: Rubric snippet to share with panel:
```
System Design: 1-4
- 1: Vague, no tradeoffs
- 2: Basic shape, misses scale/cost considerations
- 3: Solid design, calls out caching/sharding/consistency tradeoffs
- 4: Clear architecture with latency/cost estimates and rollout plan
Coding: 1-4
Communication & Collaboration: 1-4
Notes: For senior infra, lean into tradeoff reasoning and ops considerations (SLOs, observability, runbook).
```

People Ops Bot: Calendar event updated: 'Senior Infra - Interview' Thu 11:30am PT. Reminder set 30m before. Invitees: Maya K., Samir Patel, Jordan Lee, Priya Rao, Candidate. Link: calendar.redwood/evt/12345

Jordan Lee: Thanks — I'll run the debrief and post notes in the interview thread after.

Maya K.: Awesome, thanks everyone. If anything changes please ping here.
